content: सात्त्विक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [सत्त्वगुणेन तत्कार्येण मनसा वा निर्वृत्तः ठञ्] .²1 Real, essential. .²2 True, genuine, natural. .²3 Honest, sincere, good. .²4 Virtuous, amiable. .²5 Vigorous. .²6 Endowed with the quality {%Sattva%} (goodness). .²7 Belonging to or derived from the {%Sattva%} quality; ये चैव सात्त्विका भावाः <ls>Bg. 7. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">14. 16</ls>. .²8 Caused by internal feeling or sentiment (as of love), internal; तद्भूरिसात्त्विकविकारमपास्तधैर्यमाचार्यकं विजयि मान्मथमाविरासीत् <ls>Māl. 1. 26</ls>. .{@-कः@} .²1 An external indication of (internal) feeling or emotion, one of the kinds of {%Bhāvas%} in poetry; (these are eight: स्तम्भः स्वेदोऽथ रोभाञ्चः स्वरभङ्गोऽथ वेपथुः . वैवर्ण्यमश्रुप्रलय इत्यष्टौ सात्त्विकाः स्मृताः . see <ls>S. D. 164</ls> also.) .²2 A Brāhmaṇa. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Brahman. .²4 An autumn night. .{@-कम्@} An oblation (without pouring water). .{@-की@} <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
